title: How do I edit a video for free?
problem_statement: You have video clips and want to turn them into a finished video (trimmed, in order, with titles and sound) without paying for software.
expected_outcome: A finished video file exported at a resolution suitable for where you will share it.

steps.title: Choose an editor that runs on your computer
steps.instructions: Check your operating system, then pick a free editor that supports it. Shotcut and Kdenlive are open source; DaVinci Resolve has a free edition but is heavier to learn.
steps.expected_result: An editor installed and opening on your computer.
steps.warning: Download only from the official website.

steps.title: Gather and back up your clips
steps.instructions: Copy all clips, music and images into one folder on your computer. Keep the originals somewhere else as a backup.
steps.expected_result: One project folder with every file you need.

steps.title: Import and arrange
steps.instructions: Create a new project, import the folder and drag clips onto the timeline in the order you want.
steps.expected_result: A rough sequence of clips on the timeline.

steps.title: Trim and tidy
steps.instructions: Cut the start and end of each clip, remove mistakes and add simple transitions only where they help.
steps.expected_result: A sequence that plays smoothly with no unwanted parts.

steps.title: Add titles and sound
steps.instructions: Add a title and any captions, then balance music and voice so speech is easy to hear.
steps.warning: Only use music and footage you have the right to use.

steps.title: Export and check
steps.instructions: Export using a preset that matches where you'll share (for example, 1080p for most platforms). Watch the whole exported file once before sharing.
steps.expected_result: A video file that plays correctly from start to finish.

quality_checks: The exported file plays all the way through on another device.
Speech is clear over any music.
Text stays on screen long enough to read.

editorial.author: V2 research pass (AI-assisted, Claude)
editorial.change_summary: Researched from official sources 2026-10-21; published under owner's blanket MVP approval (D-044). Domain-expert review pending.

prerequisites: Your video clips copied to that computer

estimated_time.label: About 1–2 hours for a first short video

budget_note: All three recommended editors can be used without paying; DaVinci Resolve's paid Studio edition is optional.
device_note: These are desktop applications. Check the official system requirements, especially for DaVinci Resolve on older computers.
low_bandwidth_note: Installers can be large: download on Wi-Fi if you can. Editing itself works offline.
alternative_methods: Use the basic editor built into your phone's photo or gallery app for very short clips.
common_mistakes: Editing the only copy of your footage
Exporting at the wrong aspect ratio for the platform
privacy_or_safety_notes: Get permission before publishing videos that show other people, especially children.
